rules.cross_line_policy: one line request per touched 64-byte line
rules.merged_miss_policy: every demand may miss; only the parent allocates a unique fill
rules.inference_policy: gem5 labels and counters are offline references and never FastSim inputs

cycles_per_user_uop.formula: active scope cycles / committed user functional UOPs

perf_like_cpi_user.formula: user cycles / retired user macro instructions

perf_like_cpi_user_plus_kernel.formula: active user+kernel cycles / retired user+kernel macro instructions

perf.encoding: generic; bind raw encoding and target CPU in the experiment manifest

cycles.gem5: TaoTrace::settleCpl; exact scope ticks divided by the effective core clock period

perf.encoding: generic; precise-event availability is target dependent

retired_instructions.gem5: TaoTrace::accountCplCommit at non-microop or last-microop retirement

perf.encoding: unbound; bind BR_INST_RETIRED semantics in the experiment manifest
unbound; bind BR_MISP_RETIRED semantics in the experiment manifest

retired_branch_misses.speculation: committed branch whose prediction was wrong
retired_branch_misses.gem5: persistent original BPred redirect bit set before Decode target repair or IEW redirect and sampled at TaoTrace commit
retired_branch_misses.fastsim: configured predictor outcome for a committed branch record

committed_memory_uops.fastsim: retired FST records with load/store/atomic flags

cache_line_requests.gem5: committed physical address plus access size expansion

perf.encoding: unbound; generic dTLB-loads is load-only and is not equivalent

dtlb_accesses.speculation: committed demand only in the current oracle
dtlb_accesses.gem5: one committed DynInst data translation; LSQRequest::markDelayed records whether any fragment required a hardware page-table walk
dtlb_accesses.fastsim: one IntervalCore data-translation lookup per committed memory UOP

dtlb_misses.speculation: committed demand only in the current oracle
dtlb_misses.gem5: sticky committed DynInst miss result set by the real x86 timing-TLB delayed/page-walk path; independent of TaoTrace packet/fallback cache attribution

perf.encoding: unbound; generic L1-dcache-loads is load-only and is not equivalent

l1d_tag_accesses.speculation: committed demand only in the current oracle
l1d_tag_accesses.gem5: native v5: one MESI Three Level L0 D-cache SLICC profile outcome per Sequencer mandatory-queue enqueue; TaoTrace path_class remains a separate proxy diagnostic

l1d_tag_misses.speculation: committed demand only in the current oracle
l1d_tag_misses.gem5: native v5: MESI_Three_Level-L0cache uu_profileDataMiss action; permission upgrades are counted separately

private_l2_tag_accesses.speculation: committed demand only in the current oracle
private_l2_tag_accesses.gem5: native v5: MESI_Three_Level-L1cache SLICC profile actions reached from L0 misses/upgrades
private_l2_tag_accesses.fastsim: CoreCounters.l2.accesses; direct I-side requests are reported separately in CoreCounters.instruction_l2

private_l2_tag_misses.speculation: committed demand only in the current oracle
private_l2_tag_misses.gem5: native v5: MESI_Three_Level-L1cache uu_profileMiss action; permission upgrades are counted separately
private_l2_tag_misses.fastsim: CoreCounters.l2.misses; direct I-side requests use the separate CoreCounters.instruction_l2 domain while sharing cache state

permission_upgrades.gem5: native v5: explicit L0/L1/shared-L2 SLICC permission-upgrade profile actions, reported per hierarchy level

remote_supplies.unit: demand supplied by a remote private cache
remote_supplies.gem5: native v5: MESI_Two_Level-L2cache remote-owner-supply transition outcome

perf.encoding: unbound; generic LLC-loads is load-only and is not equivalent

llc_tag_accesses.speculation: committed demand only in the current oracle
llc_tag_accesses.gem5: native v5: MESI_Two_Level-L2cache SLICC hit/miss/upgrade/merged/remote outcome actions
llc_tag_accesses.fastsim: SimulationStats.llc.accesses; conserved as ChaCounters.requests = hit + tag miss + upgrade + merged + remote; direct I-side requests use separate instruction_llc/instruction_cha counters

llc_tag_misses.speculation: committed demand only in the current oracle
llc_tag_misses.gem5: native v5: MESI_Two_Level-L2cache uu_profileMiss action; upgrades, merged misses, and remote supplies are disjoint outcomes
llc_tag_misses.fastsim: SimulationStats.llc.misses; excludes permission upgrades, merged misses, remote supplies, and direct I-side requests (reported separately in SimulationStats.instruction_llc)

llc_merged_misses.unit: secondary demand merged behind an outstanding line fill
llc_merged_misses.gem5: native v5: MESI_Two_Level-L2cache uu_profileMergedMiss action for a demand arriving behind an existing TBE

llc_unique_fills.unit: parent LLC miss allocating one fill
llc_unique_fills.gem5: native v5: MESI_Two_Level-L2cache completed parent fill observed at tu_observeUniqueFill; distinct from every LLC tag miss

ruby_memory_fetches.speculation: one protocol fetch issued by the parent shared-cache miss
ruby_memory_fetches.gem5: native v5: MESI_Two_Level-L2cache a_issueFetchToMemory; explicitly not a DRAM transaction
ruby_memory_fetches.fastsim: no dedicated production counter; do not alias ChaCounters.dram_reads

ruby_memory_read_transactions.speculation: counted only when AbstractController memoryPort.sendTimingReq accepts the read; retries do not double count
ruby_memory_read_transactions.gem5: native v5: AbstractController::serviceMemoryQueue accepted MEMORY_READ packet; not a DRAM command, burst, or host IMC PMU event

perf.encoding: unbound to a target IMC PMU

dram_reads.gem5: unavailable: v5 exposes an accepted Ruby memory-port read packet, which is intentionally not relabeled as a DRAM command/burst
